pm.seasoning: 5 dummy wafers run after the clean

claims.statement: PM-633 was wet clean wall buildup removed with new showerhead and 5 dummy seasoning wafers, pre-PM recipe time 61.64 s vs baseline 60.0 s for clean chamber, target 500.0 A, so old recipe will run thick

History PM-270 same wet clean showerhead replaced new with 5 dummy seasoning had first wafers vs later -0.72 A and thickness slope -0.71 A per lot, while PM-214 skipped seasoning had -7.84 A, so with seasoning monitors are trustworthy but expect thinning
Monitor 1 at 61.64 s measured 518.13 A rate 8.4058 A per s runs since PM 1 confirming thick after clean
Monitor 2 at 61.64 s measured 519.63 A rate 8.4301 A per s runs since PM 2 confirming repeat thick
Combined rate 8.4179 A per s gives recipe 59.4 s for 500 A change -3.64 pct vs pre-PM, pre-PM time would give 518.88 A
Matching check 5.6 hours ago reference 500.0 A MET01 499.61 A MET02 499.84 A MET02 minus MET01 0.23 A negligible so no offset needed

release.summary: Wet clean removed buildup; 2 monitors at 61.64 s read 518-519 A giving rate 8.42 and recipe 59.4 s for 500 A within limit. Same work as PM-270 with seasoning and new showerhead thinned early, so set drift 0.71 with lambda 0.3. Metrology 0.23 A offset negligible.
